text:
I haven't changed anything, because this app can't do that. It has no archive action. A contact's status can only be new, pending, accepted or declined, and the only bulk actions are accept and decline. It also has no "last replied" filter I can select on. The only reply history is in each contact's activity list, and I'd have to read those one by one across 3,412 contacts.

Declining them would be the closest thing, but that isn't archiving and I don't want to swap one for the other without your say-so.

Here are some options:
- **Decline instead:** tell me which group counts as "not replied", for example pending contacts at a particular company. I'll count them and decline them.
- **Check specific people:** give me names or ids and I'll look at their activity history.
